requirements_summary: Primary workload: offline reranking for product search. Candidate generation stays in ES/BM25; Redwood will host reranking models and offer rerank endpoint + batch/offline scoring. Targets: p95 latency <= 150ms for single-query rerank (top-100 candidates), throughput target ~400-600 QPS for peak; offline batch scoring throughput target ~5M docs/day. Must support recall-preserving fallbacks and versioned model rollouts. Need ability to run A/B on reranker ranks and export score vectors for downstream analytics.
poc_details: POC scope: 2 weeks. Deliverables: 1) hosted_api rerank endpoint integration (server -> hosted), 2) offline batch scorer for nightly re-rank, 3) evaluation harness (10k queries, candidate set size=100), 4) baseline + Redwood runs (BM25 baseline, Redwood rerank top-k), 5) simple dashboard with MRR/NDCG and token-cost breakdown.
evaluation_metrics: Primary: NDCG@10, MRR, precision@1. Secondary: cost-per-query, p95 latency, model regression alerts on eval set. Requirement: exportable CSV of scored candidates and run metadata.
